newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN BANKS TO MEET IMF OFFICIAL OVER THAI ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN BANKS TO MEET IMF OFFICIAL OVER THAI ISSUE.

text.p: A group of 21 Japanese banks will meet with a senior official of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Tuesday to discuss the recent economic conditions in Thailand, an official at the Federation of Bankers Associations of Japan said on Monday.

The federation official said Japanese banks that have branches and representative offices in Thailand will attend the meeting, along with Kunio Saito, director of the IMF's regional office for Asia and the Pacific.
The meeting will start at 2.30 p.m. (0530 GMT) on Tuesday and will probably last one hour, he said.
A meeting of creditors opened in Tokyo on Monday to discuss a loan package to help ease Thailand's financial crisis.
